Definition: Ater, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ater = "binder"; 1) an exiled descendant of Hezekiah; 2) an exiled Levite porter (perhaps same as 1); 3) a chief Israelite who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
